html:
In the app

File → New Project… → Card Sort Cell opens the cell in Automatic, with its tags made and an empty routine.

The Card Sort Cell is the bench fixture for Level 11’s camera cards, modelled on a real one: a baseboard with a red fixture on it, holding a magazine of the eighteen Level 11 cards on a grip ramp, a nest under a ring light, and a PASS tray and a FAIL tray; a copy stand with an In-Sight camera (Vision_1) and a DataMan code reader (Code_1) over the nest; a push button, PASS and FAIL lamps, a TCP socket and an HMI. Vision_1 judges the card in the nest (cap, label, fill, and the lot code against the lot it was told), Code_1 reads its serial, the simulated camera answers over TCP after each inspection, and the cell keeps a tally against the answer key.

How the cards move

The cell’s Card motion setting decides who moves the cards. By hand: in Run mode, click the magazine to feed the next card and a tray to sort it. Automatic (the default in the New Project card): the cell feeds the next card when the nest is empty and sorts the card in the nest on the camera’s result, code 0 to PASS and anything else to FAIL. PLC: the cell gives the program three outputs, Feed, Sort_Pass and Sort_Fail (each acts on its rising edge), and a Pusher_Home input. A feed is the pusher: the block at the end of the ramp runs out to the magazine in half a second, carrying the bottom card into the nest, and goes home.

The tags

The cell starts with these tags made, for the program you write:

TagTypeAlias forDescription
Push_1BOOLLocal:1:I.Data.4Push button
Lamp_PassBOOLLocal:4:O.Data.0PASS lamp
Lamp_FailBOOLLocal:4:O.Data.1FAIL lamp
Card_In_NestBOOLLocal:1:I.Data.0A card is in the nest
Mag_EmptyBOOLLocal:1:I.Data.1The magazine is empty
Mag_CountINTLocal:7:I.Ch0DataCards left in the magazine
Sorted_PassBOOLLocal:1:I.Data.2Pulse: a card went into the PASS tray
Sorted_FailBOOLLocal:1:I.Data.3Pulse: a card went into the FAIL tray
TCP_SendBOOLLocal:4:O.Data.2TCP: rising edge sends LOT {SendValue} to the camera
TCP_LotINTLocal:8:O.Ch0DataTCP: the lot number sent as LOT n
TCP_ConnectedBOOLLocal:1:I.Data.5TCP: connection up
TCP_RxCountINTLocal:7:I.Ch2DataTCP: answers received

Writing the cell’s program

The cell has no reference program yet; it is the exercise. With Card motion on PLC, a first program needs: a run seal-in on the push button; a feed when the nest is empty, the pusher is home and the magazine is not; a camera trigger once the card is in the nest (the handshake of Level 8, chapter 40); and a sort on the result, PASS on code 0 and FAIL otherwise, with the lamps. The tally on the HMI tells you how your program did against the answer key.

Try it

Run the cell in Automatic first and watch the tally build up, so you know what right looks like. Then switch Card motion to PLC and write the four parts above, one at a time, running after each.
